levels.surface: عبد الله بن شداد بن الهاد

notes: «أن محمد بن عمرو بن عطاء، أخبره» : «أخبره» makes him the link (rule 5)
«أنه قال دخلنا على عائشة» : Abdullah b. Shaddad's own account; Aisha is the source of the Prophet's words inside the scene, so she is the last link
«فقلت صنعتهن» is Aisha's speech in the scene; the Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link
